author.name: Horace Chan
author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text:
I talked to a friend (non engineer) at another S&P500 company, their AI adoption is at Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT/Claude desktop app level

They don't get any explicit token limit, the limit comes with the monthly subscription

It costs $300 to subscribe to all 3 a month, big companies may have some discounts and they may only keep one eventually.

So we can reasonably estimate non tech workers will spend $100 per month on AI, combined with what I heard last time, tech workers will spend $1000 per month on AI

We can roughly estimate the total addressable market of AI and calculate how high the AI bubble could go
